title: Minimax Risk and Honest Intervals under Bounded-Curvature Interference on Disjoint Cliques
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=subfield < floor=field (target=field) and NOT salvageable in scope; mathematical core passes with all three cited sources verified-attested. Main validity gate confirms the field-tier gap requires substantive expansion beyond the present fixed-clique kernel.
gap_reasons: The delivered characterization is confined to disjoint labeled cliques under half-Bernoulli assignment with a publicly justified curvature budget; it establishes no precision guarantee for the original Twitter or ridesharing topology.
The all-regime answer remains a binomial convex modulus, with explicit rate formulas confined to selected boundaries and one intermediate regime, limiting immediate interpretation for practitioners.

The strict DN and HT separation concerns their specified scores on that intermediate sequence; it does not establish superiority over the higher-order corrections already discussed by [Peng–Ye–Zheng](https://arxiv.org/html/2503.02271v1).

The prospective consumer supplies neither a calibrated schedule budget nor an executed uncertainty analysis, and the asserted rational diagnostic replays lack accompanying reproducible artifacts in the delivered package.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived matched full-record MSE and separately honest connected-interval-length frontiers over the entire bounded Boolean-curvature class on disjoint cliques, including rational-input polynomial certificate extraction. D0.5 mathematics passed and all three generic cited substrates were source-attested, but the final package was graded subfield below the fixed field floor (score ceiling 6.9 versus 7.4), with no same-scope repair. Formalization was not entered, so there is no Lean or kernel verification; the informal results and source receipts remain reusable. Field-tier re-raise requires broader graph/design results, a broad explicit phase characterization, or substantive calibrated and reproducible application evidence; the accepted-bank comparison and two ballast editorial findings also remain disclosed.
tldr: Under one fixed half-Bernoulli assignment on labeled disjoint cliques, a binomial endpoint modulus on \(d+2\) path coordinates characterizes entire-class causal MSE and finite \(95\%\)-honest connected-interval length up to absolute constants. Observable count weights attain both frontiers, with separate all-procedure converses and affine, saturation, endpoint, and intermediate boundaries. The bounded Boolean smoothness class is the clique specialization of the source class. Certified polynomial extraction is proved for rational budgets and requested precision; ideal weights and exact-real comparison cover the all-real statistical frontier.

Neither verified result characterizes both finite full-record losses over the maintained arbitrary Boolean second-difference class.
